title: Changelog - April 2019
content:
## Changelog - April 2019


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000093686

New Features: We improved the functionality of the Pin Featured Posts Add-On, by adding the ability to specify a date the Featured Post expires. In order to use this new feature, navigate to the Admin >> Content >> Manage Posts .  Note: This update only will be available if the site has the Pin Featured Posts Add-On active. The Lead Form title is now fully compatible with the Front-End Text Label Editor tool. We added the ability to show the Website Timezone below Date, Time, and Datetime picker field. In order to enable this new feature, navigate to the Admin >> Settings >> General Settings >> Configuration Tab. The "Promo Discount" text in the Order Summary on Checkout pages is now a Text Label. New Text label: promo_discount_label. The Auto-Recurring Event Add-On is now fully compatible with the" Order Results By" Setting on the Edit Post Settings page in the Admin. Choosing a language using the Language Setting in the Configuration tab on the General Settings page of the Admin will now also update the language of PDF invoices generated by the site. The title tags of the available buttons on the Profile Photo and Logo page in the Member Dashboard can now be edited via Text Labels. New Labels: photo_zoom_in, photo_zoom_out, photo_move_left, photo_move_right, photo_move_up, photo_move_down, photo_rotate_left, photo_rotate_right, photo_flip_vertical, photo_flip_horizontal, photo_crop. We added a filter field to the Edit Post Settings page in the Admin. We refactored the Reviews feature search to be controlled by a widget called "Search - Reviews - Search Query". Also, we created a new Reviews Filter Search Module. In order to use this new Reviews Filter Search Module, navigate to the Admin >> Content >> Edit Post Settings >> Reviews >> Search Results Tab >> Sidebar Search Module. We added integrations with ShareaSale and PostAffiliatePro.  These can be integrated on a site by entering the corresponding information in the General Settings >> Integrations tab in the Admin. We released the Filter By Star Rating Add-On. Click here for more information. We added the ability to export Contacts as a CSV file. In order to use this new feature, navigates to the Admin >> Emails >> View Contacts. We added the ability to control how many results will display per row in Recent Homepage Widgets. In order to use this feature, navigate to the Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings >> Homepage Layout tab >> Homepage Section Order Options. We created a new Design Setting to control the background color of post images on Post Search Results and Post Details pages. In order to use this new feature, navigate to the Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings >> Design Settings tab >> Additional Design Setting section. Select2 dropdown fields marked as required in the Form Manager will now be treated as required when displayed on a site. We created a new Design Setting to control whether or not a "View All' button on displays in the Recent Member homepage widget. In order to use this new feature, navigates to the Admin >> Settings >> Design Settings >>Homepage Layout Tab >> Homepage Section Order Options. Enhancements / Fixes: We fixed an issue which was preventing the Admin Bar to display on the frontend of websites in some cases. We fixed an issue with the Feature Members On Homepage Add-On which was causing it to not use the correct widget in some cases. The Checkbox field in the Form Manager module is fully compatible with the Required form field setting. We fixed an issue which was causing the Member Categories Autosuggest feature to not work properly if the category name included an apostrophe. We fixed an issue which was preventing the proper import of member images when importing members via CSV file. We fixed an issue with the member import tool which was causing instances of "nn" in the file creating a line break. We added "postal_code_prefix" as a supported location type in the member search system.  Now searching for a postal code prefix location will return results as expected. We fixed an issue which was causing the Event End-Date field in post forms to not display the datepicker in some cases. We fixed an issue which was causing the Edit Widget page in the Admin Panel to show the "Save Changes" confirmation alert when pressing the keyboard Space Bar in some cases. We fixed an issue which was preventing the Recent Videos homepage widget from showing the Video Details link button on iPhones. We fixed an issue which was causing Checkout pages to not function properly when the the Newsletter Signup form was displaying on the page. We fixed an issue which was causing textareas in the Admin that have code highlighting turned on to not scroll smoothly in some cases. We fixed an issue with the alignment of the success message when deleting a Menu Item in the Menu Manager in the Admin. We fixed an issue which was affecting the use of the "Insert Image" feature of the WYSIWYG when editing a web page in the Admin. We fixed an issue which was causing Members to have their status set as Past Due automatically when they had a Past Due invoice related to a lead rather than their membership. We fixed an issue with the Google Sitemap Generator Add-On which was creating empty Sitemap Files when a website does not have Member Categories or Sub-Level Categories. We improved the UI of member Profile Pages when one or more of the Send Message, Show Phone Number, and Write a Review buttons are disabled for the member's Product. We fixed an issue with the Media Manager Tool in the Admin which was prompting the user to download a JSON file when a new folder was created. We added the ability to edit the H1 title on post search results pages. New text labels: default_search_listings_text, h1_for_label, search_results_location_operand, results_for_separator. We minified some default JS files used on the frontend of sites in order to speed up the loading of these pages. We fixed an issue with the Bookmark my Favorites Add-On which was causing favorites text to overlap when search results were displayed in Grid View. We fixed an issue which was causing the H1 element on member search results pages to show unexpected text in some cases. We fixed an issue which was preventing the General Settings page in the Admin from saving when the Members-Only Content Add-On was de-activated on a site in some cases. The "Hide Reviews Star Rating Options" Product Setting will now hide the Review Stars on Review Search Results pages and Member Profile pages. We fixed an issue with the 301 Redirect feature where URLs that ends with /connect not being redirected as expected in some cases. We optimized the Google Autocomplete API feature in order to request more specific information which may lower the cost of using the API in some cases. The Filter By Top Level Category dropdown on the Member Category page will now display the categories in alphabetical order. We fixed an issue which was causing the "Write a Review" button on Member Profile pages to not display in some cases. We fixed an issue which was causing "Hide Specialties Tab" Product Setting to not work properly when Member Profile pages are set to "Display Member Content Without Tabs". We resolved an issue that was displaying a backslash after apostrophes when included in the content of an Admin account. We fixed an issue which was causing the "View Preview" button to not work properly after a member creates a new Sub-Account in their Member Dashboard. We updated the look of the "View my CV" button on member profiles pages. We updated the Sidebar Manager page in the Admin to exclude homepage widgets that do not work properly in sidebars from the list of available widgets. We fixed an issue which was preventing replies to reviews from being saved when the reply was longer that 512 characters. We updated the version of the Event Search Date picker script to better support mobile devices. We updated the Manage Products page in the Admin in to replace the "Sign Up Page" button with the message "Sign Ups Disabled" when a Product has the "Disable Signups For This Product" setting enabled. We fixed an issue which was preventing the Private Member Chat Add-On from showing the correct Sender information on the My Chat Messages page in the Member Dashboard in some cases. The Website Activity Log in the Admin now tracks when a Form is Enabled, Disabled or Deleted. We fixed an issue which was preventing members from downloading an Invoice when the Downloadable PDF Invoices Add-On is active on a Site. We improved the Admin Usernames validation to insure Admin Usernames are a valid email address format. We are no longer displaying the Breadcrumbs field when a Site Admin is editing a Static Web Page in the Admin. We updated the logic of the Listing Search Results H1 Title. Now if the /search_results SEO Template H1 Title is empty, the system will display the Feature Search Results Title as a backup. We fixed an issue which was causing the Write a Review Button to display slightly out of alignment on Member Profile pages in some cases. We updated the UI of the Leads Details page in the Member Dashboard to display the content of the lead more clearly on mobile devices. We fixed a display issue with the 301 Redirect Search Filter Field causing the search icon to overlap with the text. We updated the URL of the Menu Manager page in the Admin. We fixed a design issue on the Member Account Details page in the Admin which was causing the "Cancelled" text to display without the proper background color when a member's status is Cancelled. We fixed an issue which was causing the scroll bar to get stuck when viewing a code editor in the Admin. The Category dropdowns on Lead Forms on member profile pages will now display all Sub Categories when the member is automatically added to all categories in their Product's settings. We added Search Filter Options to the Email Templates page in the Admin to allow Email Templates to be filtered by Keyword or Category. We improved the logic of the Email Notification badge in order to only take into consideration un-read and un-archived Form Inquiry records. We fixed an issue with the sort order of Reviews on Profile pages.  Now the most recent reviews will be displayed first. In all, over 80 feature enhancements and software updates were released this month.
